generic_domain.justification: Attention mechanisms are a fundamental concept in deep learning, particularly within neural networks. The term 'Attention Models' serves as the broadest category encompassing all other specific approaches listed. It provides a comprehensive umbrella under which different types of attention mechanisms—such as 'attention modeling,' 'neural attention's,' 'structured attention's,' and others—can be subsumed. By selecting this domain, we ensure that all specified attention-based research areas are covered comprehensively.
